evidence.observation: O2 at growth onset ~1.7 ppm, consistent with a well-purged tube
O2 rises monotonically 1.7→6.5→12.2→18.7→20.7→25.3 ppm over the growth stage, an ~15x ingress trend rather than noise
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so rising O2 is not from reduced purge flow
Thermocouple holds 750 °C with plausible ~44% heater power; thermal control is normal
Controller reports running and telemetry updates each event; no staleness

args.missing_evidence: The tube pressure gauge is not installed, so I cannot cross-check for a pressure drop; a discriminating test (step Ar flow up/down and see whether O2 dilutes proportionally, indicating a fixed-rate air leak, vs. a sensor/outgassing artifact) plus post-run leak check would confirm. Note that contrary to the system check, the installed O2 sensor does give a usable atmosphere indication — and it is the channel that is abnormal.
